name: revivalside
description: Local CounterSide revival server research tooling.

scripts.check:combat-simulator: node --check combat-simulator/server.js && node --check combat-simulator/app.js && node combat-simulator/check.js
scripts.check:mod-loader: node --check modules/mod-loader/index.js && node --check server/assetViewer.js && node tools/check-mod-loader.js
scripts.check:mod-unit-maker: node --check modules/mod-unit-maker/index.js && node --check modules/unity-bundle-compiler/index.js && node tools/check-mod-unit-maker.js && node tools/check-csharp-host-runtime-refresh.js
scripts.check:mod-episode-maker: node --check modules/mod-episode-maker/index.js && node --check server/assetViewer.js && node tools/check-mod-episode-maker.js
scripts.check:listener: node --check cs-listener.js && node --check server/listener.js && node --check server/userManager.js && node --check server/packetHandlerLoader.js && node --check modules/user-db-selection/index.js && node --check tools/import-official-join-lobby-profile.js && node tools/check-frozen-client-update.js && node tools/check-user-manager-lightweight.js && node tools/check-join-lobby-login-fast-path.js && node tools/check-story-open-tags.js && node tools/check-frozen-content-compat.js && node tools/check-stage-clear-persistence.js && node tools/check-squad-loadouts.js && node tools/check-packet-handler-registry.js
scripts.check:handlers: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-ChildItem packet-handlers,modules -Recurse -Filter *.js | Where-Object { $_.DirectoryName -match '[\\/]handlers$' } | ForEach-Object { node --check $_.FullName }"
scripts.check:launcher: node --check tools/revivalside-launcher-backend.js && node tools/check-revivalside-launcher-backend.js && corepack pnpm --dir launcher build
scripts.check:modside: npm run build:modside && node --check tools/serve-modside.js && node tools/check-modside-server.js
scripts.check:wiki: node --check wiki/app.js && node --check tools/build-revivalside-wiki.js && node --check tools/ensure-wiki-assets.js && node --check tools/serve-revivalside-wiki.js && node tools/check-revivalside-wiki.js
